# Implementation Readiness Checklist: Field Management and Region Resolution

**Purpose**: Review whether SPEC-005 planning artifacts define complete, clear, consistent and implementable requirements for field management and region resolution.
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [research.md](../research.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [fields.openapi.yaml](../contracts/fields.openapi.yaml), [quickstart.md](../quickstart.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are generic Field-list requirements explicit that the result includes every Field in the server-authorized Business, remains minimal without requiring region state, and is distinct from the narrower weather-only overview projection? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–003/FR-022, Plan §Summary, SPEC-004]
- [x] CHK002 Are default and maximum page sizes, `name ASC, id ASC` order, opaque keyset continuation, duplicate-name tie-breaking, malformed-cursor outcome, and rename-between-pages behavior specified consistently? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Research §R-6, OpenAPI `GET /fields`, Quickstart §1]
- [x] CHK003 Are all supported Field create paths (current location, map point, Polygon), point-only validity, optional location permission, and server-derived Polygon representative-point rules stated without changing SPEC-001 onboarding semantics? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-008, SPEC-001]
- [x] CHK004 Does the requirement for server-assigned `Tarla N` names define first-available allocation, same-Business concurrency safety, exact generated-label availability, and acceptance of duplicate farmer-entered names? [Completeness, Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Research §R-5, Quickstart §3]
- [x] CHK005 Is blank or null name behavior on Field update explicitly defined, including whether it requests a generated label and how concurrent allocation is serialized? [Gap, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006, Data Model §Field, Research §R-5, OpenAPI `FieldUpdate`]
- [x] CHK006 Are the allowed current Field edits and excluded delete/archive behavior stated consistently across specification, data model, API contract, and out-of-scope list? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-019, Data Model §Field, OpenAPI `FieldUpdate`]
- [x] CHK007 Are Polygon-to-Polygon, Polygon-to-Point, and Point-to-Polygon transitions defined, including representative-point updates and validation failure outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007–008, Data Model §Core state transitions, Quickstart §2/§4]
- [x] CHK008 Is `FieldBoundaryVersion` history explicitly append-only, with new versions created for Polygon changes, prior versions retained, and newly submitted Polygons left unverified absent a real verification process? - [x] CHK009 Is the nullable current-boundary pointer’s meaning unambiguous (`null` means currently point-only), including migration backfill matching the pre-SPEC-005 `version DESC, id ASC` selection and season activation selecting the pointer afterward? - [x] CHK024 Is the privacy-safe denial rule mapped unambiguously to list/detail/mutation HTTP responses, especially the contract’s `403` and `404` cases, so cross-Business Field existence is never disclosed? [Ambiguity, Conflict, Spec §FR-002/Permissions, OpenAPI responses, ADR-009]

- [x] CHK026 Are required create `Idempotency-Key` semantics consistent across plan, research, data model, OpenAPI, and quickstart, including authenticated/business/command scope, durable PostgreSQL replay, changed-payload/context conflict, concurrent same-key convergence, preservation of Season command replay behavior, and separation from update `If-Match` concurrency? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, Plan §Summary, Research §R-10, Data Model §BusinessCommandIdempotencyRecord, OpenAPI `POST /fields`, Tasks T004/T006–T008/T019–T020/T023/T058, Quickstart §3]
- [x] CHK027 Are Field failure diagnostics, correlation context, and privacy constraints aligned so credentials, unnecessary personal data, and unnecessary raw location details are excluded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, Data Model §FieldRegionContextVersion, ADR-009, Architecture §46/§45]
- [x] CHK028 Are SPEC-005’s accepted boundaries consistent with the PRD and SPEC-001–004 contracts, including the explicit exclusions for delete/archive, FieldSection, other farm attributes, verification, satellite, Calendar, plan/task changes, notifications, generic offline sync, search/filter, bulk, team/advisor, finance, harvest/sales, and AI? ## Review: 2026-10-02 (re-evaluated after approved decisions)

- PASS: CHK001–CHK042. Each item was checked against its cited SPEC-005 artifact evidence; this pass rechecked prior decisions and evaluated CHK038–CHK042 after the activation, migration, navigation, idempotency, composition, and error-presentation reconciliation. These checkboxes measure artifact readiness only, not implementation or test completion:
  - CHK030: Spec FR-021 and Mobile and Connectivity Expectations define canonical refresh, preservation of attempted values, explicit farmer action, and no automatic retry/merge/rebase. Research R-7 mobile recovery and the OpenAPI PATCH 409 response retain HTTP 409 `STALE_VERSION` semantics.
  - CHK031: Spec Mobile and Connectivity Expectations and SC-010 define visible state text, screen/form-level announcements for meaningful async changes, deduplication, and non-color cues. Research R-7b maps this to existing mobile live-region/role conventions. Quickstart scenario 10 specifies repeat-render checks; no physical VoiceOver/TalkBack execution is claimed.
  - CHK036: Spec FR-007/FR-022 and SC-012, Research R-4/R-7a, Data Model, and Quickstart scenario 11 preserve duplicate legacy version values, select the old tie winner, and forbid row/version rewrites or boundary-version uniqueness.
  - CHK038–CHK042: Future activation, navigation, command-store migration, runtime composition ownership, and shared error presentation each have explicit requirements/model decisions, test tasks, dependencies, and validation scenarios.
- Total reviewed: 42. PASS: 42; FAIL: 0; NEEDS-CLARIFICATION: 0.

## Implementation Validation Evidence: 2026-10-04

The 42 checklist markers above remain a requirements-readiness review; they do not represent implementation completion. Implementation evidence for quickstart scenarios 1–8 and 10–13 is provided by the passing SPEC-005 domain, API contract/integration, activation, weather-regression, generated-client, and mobile test suites recorded in `tasks.md` verification. Scenario 9's app-level creation/edit failure and conflict behavior is covered by mobile tests. Physical permission prompts, VoiceOver, and TalkBack were not exercised on devices. Production region resolution remains unavailable because no source has passed the qualification gate; this is the approved unresolved behavior, not a test failure.
